title: pathsep

gpu_support.notes: Host-side compatibility builtin; GPU-resident inputs are gathered before execution.

behaviors: Accepts MATLAB text inputs such as string scalars and character row vectors for path, name, or URL arguments where applicable.
Runs on the host using the active RunMat filesystem, environment, or HTTP abstraction as appropriate.
Reports MATLAB-style runtime errors for unsupported argument shapes or unavailable host capabilities.
